subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

__Disclaimer __on products in the markets saves manufacturer from unusual results on usage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Clause**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disclaimer"** means a statement that denies something, especially responsibility. It is often used in legal or formal contexts to limit or exclude liability. (अस्वीकरण)

 
 
• **Example: **The disclaimer on the website states that they are not responsible for any inaccuracies in the content.
 
 
 
• **"Clause"** refers to a specific provision or section in a legal document or statement that outlines particular terms or conditions. (शर्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The contract contains a clause that protects the company from liability in case of unforeseen events.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word "Disclaimer" aligns with the meaning of "Clause" as it is often a specific condition or statement that limits liability.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Clause**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Guarantee** (गारंटी): A formal assurance that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially related to quality or performance.

 
 
• **Example: **The manufacturer offers a two-year guarantee on all electronic products.
 
 
 
• **Approval** (अनुमोदन): The act of agreeing to something or accepting it as satisfactory.
 
 
• **Example: **The new policy was implemented after receiving approval from the board members.
 
 
 
• **Acceptance** (स्वीकार्यता): The action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered.
 
 
• **Example: **The acceptance of his proposal was a turning point in his career.
